response_text: If the fundamental OS clock were changed from 1 ms to 0.1 ms, the system would gain higher timing resolution and could respond to events more quickly. This could be beneficial for real-time applications requiring fast reaction times. However, this change would also increase CPU overhead because the SysTick_Handler interrupt would trigger ten times more frequently, leaving less time for threads to execute between ticks, working the CPU harder. As a result, the performance may decrease, and power consumption may increase due to the higher clock rate.\n
